subject: Chaldean name-number chart for Name Echo readers
body:
Hi Eida and Deborah,

I was reading about Name Echo's mission to go beyond name origins into numerology meanings. Since many of your readers are already exploring what a name may carry symbolically, I thought this free Chaldean letter-values chart might be a useful reference:

https://www.namealigned.com/resources/chaldean-letter-values

It includes the full Chaldean value table, a simple example calculation, and a tiny embeddable name-number widget for readers who want to check a name directly.

If you ever update one of your name numerology pages, it could fit naturally as a practical calculation reference. Either way, thank you for the thoughtful name work you publish.

Best,
Rekha
notes: Public About page lists office[at]nameecho[dot]com. Strong fit: name meanings + numerology.
